messages:
fix: give back a single-use coupon by order id, not customer name

Paolo cancelled an order placed with his one-time welcome coupon and
reordered the same day, but the coupon was refused as already used.

OrderService.cancel passed the customer's name to Coupons.giveBack,
but Coupons.use records usage keyed by the order id, so the lookup
never matched and the coupon was never released, contradicting the
README ("cancelling it ... gives back its coupon, if the coupon was
single-use"). Fixes src/orders.ts to pass the order id instead.

Also investigated a support report of shipping charged on an order
whose goods came to exactly €50.00: this boundary was already fixed
(src/shipping.ts, task-002) and remains correct, including with a
coupon bringing goods down to the threshold; added a regression test
for that case but no code change was needed.
